plan.title: feat(session): session:start should default to one-line ready output; put ceremony behind --verbose

narratives.Description: session:start success human output defaults to one trusted ready line. Routine ceremony moves behind --verbose / DEFT_SESSION_VERBOSE. Actionable zero-exit exceptions and policy/finalize-owed notices stay on the quiet success path.
narratives.Overview: Prefer-A Recut-1 6255757053: quiet-default one-line ready; non-exhaustive always-on allowlist; deprecate tip --compact as volume gate; print-less execute-still keep-outs.
narratives.Labels: enhancement, agent-experience, urgent, area:cli, design-critique:ingest-ready, core-capabilities, promise:continuity
narratives.UserStory: As an agent or operator, I want session:start success to print one ready line by default, so that ceremony noise does not bury the go-signal while --verbose still restores the full dump when I need it.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Edit packages/core/src/session/session-start.ts and packages/runtime/src/session-start.ts for quiet-default one-line ready + --verbose/DEFT_SESSION_VERBOSE ceremony dump; cover with packages/core/src/session/session-start.test.ts and packages/runtime/src/session-start.test.ts.
2. Adjust packages/core/src/session/orientation-compression.ts (+ orientation-compression.test.ts) for the non-exhaustive always-on allowlist at the final human-output selection point.
3. Deprecate tip #3286 --compact/DEFT_SESSION_COMPACT as no-ops or remint whole-stdout with CHANGELOG.md in the same PR.
4. Update content/commands.md session:start help; CHANGELOG.md Unreleased.

items.title: relieves: P1 — Primary go-signal quiet-default: one trusted-state line ready+branch/HEAD+occupancy with stable [deft session] ready=… prefix; routine dial/host-surface/effort/orientation prose verbose-only via --verbose and DEFT_SESSION_VERBOSE=1
